objects.name: Analytic 2108
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies a write to alarm configuration files or database tables on an Human-Machine Interface (HMI)/alarm server by a process other than the recognized alarm management application, or an alarm-class-disable Application Programming Interface (API) call logged without a corresponding operator session ID in the HMI audit trail. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when the action is not attributable to an authorized operator/engineering source for the specific target and function, and it is either outside an approved change/maintenance window or lacks matching change-control context; where telemetry permits, require corroborating device, configuration, or process-state effect. Suppress activity that fully matches approved maintenance, commissioning, failover, recovery, or tested control procedures.
